notes.title: Steal Out on The Hungry Ghost Festival 2025!
notes.notes: [p]Fear is natural, especially when it comes to theft or trespassing...[/p][p align="start"]But we are not afraid of anything, so we boldly move forward and get to places others don't dare to. And this time, we ended up at The Hungry Ghost Festival 2025![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619415/29fc502e824e3bc225dc273523c1fcd0f780fc7a.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Nothing will stop us. The main thing is to cover our tracks with a featherduster afterwards ːfeatherdusterː[/p]

notes.title: The Steal Out Playtest Has Begun!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, bandits!
[/p][p]The Steal Out playtest is now live! 🎉
[/p][p]Call your friends, try the game, have fun, and influence the project's development by leaving your feedback at the end of your session. Together, we'll make Steal Out even better![/p][p][/p][p]If your friends are busy, check out our Discord server where you can find people to play with, as well as share your impressions or report any issues (it is an early version after all, and we might have missed something):[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/hAQd5BSCk2"]https://discord.gg/hAQd5BSCk2[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Any and all feedback is important to us! So dive into the action—it's time to find out who among you is the fastest, sneakiest, and most cunning thief! 💰[/p][p][/p][p]Also, this week we're attending the Gamescom offline festival in Cologne! If you're in the area, stop by the indie zone; we'd be happy to see you!
[/p][p]P.S. Don't forget to add Steal Out to your wishlist; it really helps us out! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Introducing Steal Out — A Wild PvP Multiplayer Platformer
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, heisters![/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally reveal Steal Out, our upcoming 3D PvE/PvP platformer for up to 4 players. Packed with unpredictable challenges, deadly traps, and chaotic battles, Steal Out will test your skills, strategy, and ability to outthink your opponents.[/p][p][/p][p]From cracking safes and dodging traps to pulling off daring moves in heated competition, every match is a new opportunity to rise above the rest.[/p][p][/p][p]What to expect:[/p][list][*][p]Multiple game modes: Story Campaign, Night Heist, Fight Club, King of the Hill, and more[/p][/*][*][p]Inclusive matchmaking with no language barriers[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic, fast-paced matches where every round feels different[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out our brand-new trailer below to get your first look at the madness!
[/p][previewyoutube="4HSYbmRsc_8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to share more details in the coming months — stay tuned for updates, and get ready for the wildest multiplayer experience yet.[/p][p][/p][p]— The Siberian Koala Team[/p][p]
[/p]
